prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1042; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to my situation, but I guess that's [CLAIMANT NAME].

Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Katy?
A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. Traffic was moderate, the sun was low, and I had just checked both directions. Then a vehicle came through from my right and hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see that vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. It came out of nowhere, or at least I didn't register it in time. I braked as hard as I could but it was too late.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes. The airbags went off, and my head hit the window pretty hard.

Q: How are you feeling now?
A: Not great. I have a constant headache, I get dizzy when I stand up too fast, and bright lights bother my eyes. My doctor said it's a concussion and I'm supposed to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Have you missed time from work?
A: Yes, I've been out for about two weeks so far. I can only work a few hours at a time before the headaches get too bad.

Q: Did you go to the hospital or see a doctor right after the crash?
A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room that evening. They did a CT scan and sent me home with instructions to follow up with my primary care doctor and a neurologist.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you want to add?
A: Just that I want this claim handled as quickly as possible, since I'm still struggling every day.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
